four_new_steps.name: Export the source-bound full FFN pipeline certificate
Rebuild the FFN certificate and refuse four direct Lean dependency changes
Refuse 31 coherently rehashed FFN recordings before fresh Lean work
Retain FFN certificate and control reports and Lean logs
four_new_steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
for name in ('lark-ptx-ffn-ci-export', 'lark-ptx-ffn-ci-source-controls',
             'lark-ptx-ffn-ci-recording-controls'):
    root = Path('/tmp') / name
    for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
        relative = p.relative_to(root)
        if 'recording' in relative.parts:
            continue
        if p.is_file() and (p.name in ('results.json', 'replay.json') or p.suffix == '.log'):
            print(json.dumps({'FFN_evidence': name + '/' + str(relative),
                              'text': p.read_text()}), flush=True)
PY
